notes.hook: The concept of a spacecraft bouncing a whole kilometer high instantly captures curiosity.
notes.clarity: The narrative explains the mechanical failure, low-gravity rebound, and outcome clearly in plain terms.
notes.payoff: Concluding with all ten instruments successfully collecting data provides a satisfying turnaround.
notes.visuals: Crisp, relevant imagery of Comet 67P, the lander, and the actual mission control team.
notes.loop: The closing phrase transitions smoothly back into the opening hook line.

rounds.better_than_last: It delivers a tighter narrative arc of tension and resolution around a specific historical mission than recent episodes.
